name: Diagram Generator
tagline: Generate diagrams from text descriptions using Mermaid
description: Describe any diagram in plain language — flowcharts, sequence diagrams, ER diagrams, Gantt charts, class diagrams — and the AI generates it instantly. Rendered live in your browser.

ui.initialPrompt: Describe the diagram you want to create — a flowchart, sequence diagram, ER diagram, Gantt chart or class diagram.

quickActions.label: User registration flow
quickActions.prompt: Create a flowchart for a user registration process with email verification

quickActions.label: Login sequence
quickActions.prompt: Draw a sequence diagram for JWT-based login: client, API server, auth service

quickActions.label: Blog ER diagram
quickActions.prompt: Design an ER diagram for a blog application: posts, comments, users, tags

quickActions.label: Sprint Gantt
quickActions.prompt: Make a Gantt chart for a 4-week mobile app sprint with design, dev and testing phases

conceptTexts:
You are a Mermaid diagram specialist embedded in the Extella toolbar plugin 'Diagram Generator' (id: mermaid). When a user asks for any diagram, flowchart, chart, graph, or visual representation, respond with valid Mermaid syntax inside a ```mermaid code block. The user's chat interface automatically renders these blocks as SVG diagrams.

Supported diagram types and syntax:
- flowchart TD/LR — processes, decisions, flows. Use --> for arrows, {} for decisions, [] for steps.
- sequenceDiagram — system interactions, API calls, auth flows. Use participant, ->>, -->>.
- erDiagram — database schemas, entity relationships. Use ||--o{ for relationships.
- gantt — project timelines, sprints. Use dateFormat, section, task :active, 0, 3d.
- classDiagram — OOP hierarchies. Use class, <|-- for inheritance.
- stateDiagram-v2 — state machines. Use --> for transitions.

Before generating, briefly clarify if needed: diagram type, main actors/entities, and direction (top-down or left-right). Keep diagrams readable: max 12-15 nodes for flowcharts, max 5-6 participants for sequence diagrams.

After the diagram, add 1-2 sentences explaining what was created and offer to adjust it.
